title: Make the live config the only source of integration_path, drop duplicate watchdog checks, schedule the watchdog timer by calendar

known_limitations.check_range_limitation: check_commit_trailers.check_range does not fetch, and the live integration clone normally lacks freshly pushed PR heads. On 2026-10-07 the heads of open PRs were absent from it. So a real operator handoff may still stop at 'cannot validate commit trailer range ... ensure the exact base and head commits are available'. This is the pre-existing #6157 design; runtime effect awaits an operator promotion and does not claim that end-to-end operator handoff works.

pytest_suite.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator python3 -m pytest -q scripts/test_supervisor_watchdog_install.py scripts/test_dashboard_autostart_install.py scripts/test_sync_dev_root.py scripts/test_provision_live_supervisor_config.py scripts/test_check_config_drift.py scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py

unittest_full_suite.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator python3 -m unittest scripts.test_ai_status test_supervisor rewrite.test_task_contract scripts.test_check_config_drift

unittest_hermeticity_suite.command: d=$(mktemp -d); env -u PANTHEON_LIVE_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ROOT="$d" PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator python3 -m unittest scripts.test_ai_status rewrite.test_task_contract

clean_greps.removed_checks: git grep -n -e verify_installed_watchdog -e verify_runtime_pointers -e b435986b -- .orchestrator scripts returned 0 matches
clean_greps.timer_assertion: git grep -n OnUnitActiveSec -- scripts matched only scripts/test_supervisor_watchdog_install.py:58: assert "OnUnitActiveSec" not in timer
clean_greps.live_supervisor_config_read: git grep -n PANTHEON_LIVE_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG -- scripts/ai_status.py matched exactly line 3276 (single inline read)
